upgradeCatalog.jobs_operational_summary_dead_idx: CREATE INDEX jobs_operational_summary_dead_idx ON operations.jobs USING btree (available_at, job_id) INCLUDE (attempt_count) WHERE (status = 'dead'::text)
upgradeCatalog.jobs_operational_summary_lease_idx: CREATE INDEX jobs_operational_summary_lease_idx ON operations.jobs USING btree (lease_expires_at, job_id) INCLUDE (attempt_count, lease_acquired_at) WHERE (status = 'leased'::text)
upgradeCatalog.jobs_operational_summary_status_idx: CREATE INDEX jobs_operational_summary_status_idx ON operations.jobs USING btree (status, available_at, job_id) INCLUDE (attempt_count, lease_expires_at) WHERE (status = ANY (ARRAY['available'::text, 'leased'::text, 'dead'::text]))
upgradeCatalog.outbox_events_operational_summary_dead_i: CREATE INDEX outbox_events_operational_summary_dead_idx ON operations.outbox_events USING btree (dead_at, event_id) INCLUDE (attempt_count) WHERE (dead_at IS NOT NULL)
upgradeCatalog.outbox_events_operational_summary_eligib: CREATE INDEX outbox_events_operational_summary_eligible_idx ON operations.outbox_events USING btree (occurred_at, event_id) INCLUDE (available_at, attempt_count, lease_expires_at, lease_acquired_at) WHERE ((completed_at IS NULL) AND (dead_at IS NULL))
upgradeCatalog.outbox_events_operational_summary_lease_: CREATE INDEX outbox_events_operational_summary_lease_idx ON operations.outbox_events USING btree (lease_expires_at, event_id) INCLUDE (available_at, attempt_count, lease_acquired_at) WHERE ((lease_expires_at IS NOT NULL) AND (completed_at IS NULL) AND (dead_at IS NULL))
upgradeCatalog.outbox_events_operational_summary_retry_: CREATE INDEX outbox_events_operational_summary_retry_idx ON operations.outbox_events USING btree (available_at, occurred_at, event_id) INCLUDE (attempt_count) WHERE ((completed_at IS NULL) AND (dead_at IS NULL) AND (attempt_count > 0))
upgradeCatalog.owner_exports_operational_summary_expire: CREATE INDEX owner_exports_operational_summary_expired_idx ON portability.owner_exports USING btree (portfolio_id, expired_at DESC, export_id DESC) WHERE ((status = 'expired'::text) AND (expired_at IS NOT NULL))
upgradeCatalog.owner_exports_operational_summary_failed: CREATE INDEX owner_exports_operational_summary_failed_idx ON portability.owner_exports USING btree (portfolio_id, failed_at DESC, export_id DESC) WHERE ((status = 'failed'::text) AND (failed_at IS NOT NULL))
upgradeCatalog.owner_exports_operational_summary_ready_: CREATE INDEX owner_exports_operational_summary_ready_idx ON portability.owner_exports USING btree (portfolio_id, completed_at DESC, export_id DESC) INCLUDE (started_at, artifact_content_length) WHERE ((status = 'ready'::text) AND (completed_at IS NOT NULL))
upgradeCatalog.owner_exports_operational_summary_recent: CREATE INDEX owner_exports_operational_summary_recent_idx ON portability.owner_exports USING btree (portfolio_id, status, requested_at DESC, export_id DESC) INCLUDE (started_at, completed_at, artifact_content_length)
